mapper.insert: INSERT INTO check_ins (user_id, check_in_date, points, created_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{checkInDate}, #{points}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(points), 0) FROM check_ins WHERE user_id = #{userId}
SELECT c.user_id AS userId, COALESCE(SUM(c.points), 0) AS totalPoints FROM check_ins c INNER JOIN users u ON c.user_id = u.id GROUP BY c.user_id ORDER BY totalPoints DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM check_ins WHERE check_in_date = CURDATE()
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM check_ins WHERE DATE_FORMAT(check_in_date, '%Y-%m') = #{yearMonth}
